Inside, rolled meticulously, was a scrap of yellowed paper bearing a date from fifty years ago and a single, haunting sentence: \"Tell them I am still waiting by the northern cliff.\" Arthur stared out at the grey, indifferent expanse of the ocean, wondering whose past he had just dredged up from the deep.", "w02": "夜色尚未完全退去，四点的城市呈现出一种奇妙的静谧。路灯在薄雾中晕开橘黄的光圈，环卫工人的扫帚划过地面，发出沙沙的声响。早起的菜贩正将新鲜的蔬菜卸下车，带着泥土的芬芳。远处的立交桥上，零星的汽车疾驰而过，车轮卷起清冷的晨风。高楼大厦的玻璃幕墙开始倒映出鱼肚白的微光，整座城市像是在长长的呼吸中缓缓苏醒，即将迎来新的一天。", "w03": "To understand recursion, you must first understand recursion.\nIt is simply a process that calls upon a smaller version of itself to solve a bigger problem.\nAlways ensure there is a base case so the loop finally stops."}
